name: arbor-family-tree
description: Obsidian plugin for visualising family trees from person notes

scripts.build: npm run build:html && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp main.js manifest.json ~/Obsidian/PersonalDB/.obsidian/plugins/arbor-family-tree/ && cp manifest.json ../manifest.json
